title: I Made $10K Last Month From a Skill I Learned in 3 Months (Here's How)
audience: Ambitious 18-28 year olds, figuring out careers and finances
tone: High energy, direct, trend-aware, hype best friend energy

concept.hook: I spent $0 on a course and made $10K in my fourth month using one skill I learned for free on YouTube.

shots.camera: [Static vertical] Close-up reaction face, phone screen visible
shots.narration: I spent zero dollars on a course. And I made ten thousand dollars in my fourth month using one skill I learned for free on YouTube.

shots.prompt: Vertical screen-share style animation. Three steps appear one by one with icons: 1. MAGNIFYING GLASS icon labeled 'Find the gap' — small businesses needing help. 2. LAPTOP icon labeled 'Learn free' — YouTube, Reddit, Notion. 3. PHONE icon labeled 'Sell now' — LinkedIn DM template.
shots.narration: Not a get-rich-quick. A framework. Step one: find the gap. What do small businesses need that they can't do themselves? Websites, content, ads, admin work. Step two: learn it for free. All the information is on YouTube. Step three: sell before you're ready. Message 20 businesses on LinkedIn. One yes and you have a portfolio.
shots.sfx: TikTok transition sounds, app notification pings

shots.prompt: Split vertical — left: rejected job application. Right: LinkedIn DM reply notification. Hand types rapidly. Coffee shop background, energetic but focused. Overlays show: 1 application vs 1 DM response. Arrow pointing up.
shots.camera: [Static split vertical] Side-by-side comparison in vertical format

shots.sfx: Rejection sound vs notification ping, keyboard typing energy

shots.prompt: Vertical shot. Person standing, confident, direct to camera. Coffee shop behind them. Hand gesture: pointing at viewers. Eye contact, high energy. Follow button animation on screen edge.
